title: Lower Invertebrates
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a group of animals (and animal-like organisms) that do not have a backbone."
The invertebrates are a group of animals (and animal-like organisms) that do not have a backbone.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those invertebrates without specific organs."
The lower invertebrates are those invertebrates without specific organs.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the simplest Metazoa, and do not even possess organs."
The Cnidaria are the simplest Metazoa, and do not even possess organs.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the region of the body just behind the scolex."
The neck is the region of the body just behind the scolex.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a system in which information on organisms are gathered and stored in an orderly manner for easy retrieval."
Classification is a system in which information on organisms are gathered and stored in an orderly manner for easy retrieval.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a common free- living nematode."
Vinegar eel is a common free- living nematode.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used in movement and are aided by cells called rhabdoids that secrete a mucous blanket on which the worm glides."
The cilia are used in movement and are aided by cells called rhabdoids that secrete a mucous blanket on which the worm glides.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the first, and it begins with an uppercase letter and the second is the specific name, which begins with a lower case letter."
The generic name is the first, and it begins with an uppercase letter and the second is the specific name, which begins with a lower case letter.
fib: ______ are known to exhibit both asexual (gemmules) and sexual reproduction (usually hermaphroditic).
sponges
The sponges are known to exhibit both asexual (gemmules) and sexual reproduction (usually hermaphroditic).
______ are the most specialised of the Platyhelminthes parasites.
Cestodes or tapeworms
Cestodes or tapeworms are the most specialised of the Platyhelminthes parasites.
______ is a derivative of "Sarcodina" (which is an older term used for amoeboids) and "Mastigophora" (which is an older term for flagellates).
phylum Sarcomastigophora
The phylum Sarcomastigophora is a derivative of "Sarcodina" (which is an older term used for amoeboids) and "Mastigophora" (which is an older term for flagellates).
______ are a small phylum of small and poorly understood animals.
Mesozoa
The Mesozoa are a small phylum of small and poorly understood animals.
______ is a class within the phylum Platyhelminthes that contains two groups of parasitic worms, commonly referred to as flukes.
Trematoda
The Trematoda is a class within the phylum Platyhelminthes that contains two groups of parasitic worms, commonly referred to as flukes.
______ are a large class of ribbon-shaped flatworms found primarily on the bottoms of oceans.
Turbellarians
The Turbellarians are a large class of ribbon-shaped flatworms found primarily on the bottoms of oceans.
______ are the simplest and most primitive multicellular animals, because, despite their multicellular nature, their component cells are not organized into tissues and organs.
parazoans
The parazoans are the simplest and most primitive multicellular animals, because, despite their multicellular nature, their component cells are not organized into tissues and organs.
______ is a diverse group of very simple-bodied animals includes corals, sea anemones, hydras, jellyfishes, and their relatives.
phylum Cnidaria
The phylum Cnidaria is a diverse group of very simple-bodied animals includes corals, sea anemones, hydras, jellyfishes, and their relatives.
